projectDescription: An end-to-end deep learning system for multi-class video classification using a two-stage CNN + Bi-LSTM + Multi-Head Attention architecture, achieving ~93-95% accuracy on animation, gaming, natural, and flat content categories.
keyFeatures: Two-stage CNN + Bi-LSTM + Multi-Head Attention architecture for spatial-temporal video understanding
Multi-scale feature extraction using ResNet-50/101 and EfficientNet-V2-S/M backbones
4-model ensemble with Test-Time Augmentation (TTA) achieving ~95% classification accuracy
Four video content categories: Animation, Gaming, Natural Content, and Flat Content
Flask-based web application for real-time single-video inference
Trained on NVIDIA A100 GPU (MIG partition) with 251 GB RAM
Focal Loss with Label Smoothing and AdamW optimizer with Cosine Annealing
Pre-extracted HDF5 feature storage for fast inference without re-running CNN
publicApiSurface: GET /api/videos — list available dataset videos by category
POST /api/classify — classify a dataset video with optional TTA and per-model breakdown
EnhancedFeatureExtractor — extract multi-scale CNN features from video splits
SingleVideoClassifier — load ensemble checkpoints and predict on a single video
SingleVideoFeatureLoader — load pre-extracted features from HDF5 for a named video
EnhancedTemporalModelTrainer — training loop with validation, checkpointing, and visualization
FocalLoss — focal loss with label smoothing for imbalanced classification
